reviewNotes: Reviewed all 105 exported speech keys against all 20 source cards in data/pages47-49-usage.json. Corrected annotation duplication and residual kanji for めんきりぼうちょう, そばきりぼうちょう, ほねすきぼうちょう, ふぐひきぼうちょう and ほねすき; corrected incomplete 飾り切 and 引き切 readings to かざりぎり and ひきぎり. Checked contextual topic は → わ, directional へ → え, object を → お. Preserved lexical 刃 は, はば, はわたり, はせん, はめん, はったつ, はずす, はこぶ, はし, はら, はじめず, lexical へた and 家庭で かていで. Checked かつらむき, かまがたうすば, きっさき, さんまい, なかぼね, こまいた and knife names against source furigana. Loanwords converted to hiragana retaining long vowels; arrows and slash rendered as pauses. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
